Smoke test: XLSX with basic spreadsheet data including tables

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind
from xberg._xberg import ExtractionConfig

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), mime_type="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet", uri="https://example.com/xlsx/stanley_cups.xlsx")
    config = ExtractionConfig.from_json("{}")
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].metadata)

asyncio.run(main())
```
